title: UneceEnvelope
description: A structure providing XHE (Exchange Header Envelope) information.

includedPayload.description: The payload included in this XHE envelope.

metadataDocument.description: The document metadata for this XHE envelope.

versionId.description: The version identifier for this XHE envelope.
